annotatedSteps.description: First observation justifying chemical change (evolution of gas)
annotatedSteps.studentWork: 1. Zinc granules के आसपास gas के bubbles बनते हैं — यानी gas का evolution होता है (H₂ gas)।
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Correct observation: evolution of hydrogen gas noted.

annotatedSteps.description: Second observation justifying chemical change (rise in temperature)
annotatedSteps.studentWork: 2. Flask को छूने पर वह गरम लगता है, मतलब temperature में rise होता है।
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Correct observation: rise in temperature (exothermic reaction) noted.

teacherNote: Marked against: Observation 1: Evolution of a gas / formation of bubbles (hydrogen gas) (1); Observation 2: Change in temperature / flask becomes warm (rise in temperature / exothermic reaction) (1). Both observations—evolution of gas and change in temperature—are accurately stated to justify that a chemical reaction has occurred. Excellent work!
